intro: Space itself warps as {{adeusName}} reveals its form!
title: Adeus
description:
An entity of unknown origin said to rival Arceus itself, Adeus, blocks your way.
Defeat it, and you'll be able to use Adeus as a starter forever after.

1.label: Accept the challenge
1.tooltip:
(-) Extremely Tough Battle
(+) Unlocks Adeus as a starter
1.selected: Adeus watches you without moving.$The battle begins!

outro: Adeus's power fades completely, and it collapses.
